title: Stop Typing One Line Into AI (The 5-Part Prompt)
description:
Most people use AI like a search box: one line in, one generic answer out, then twenty minutes fixing it. This is the five-part prompt that gets work you'd actually send - Role, Context, Task, Format, and Examples - with a real before-and-after on the same task.

In a Harvard/BCG study of 758 professionals, those using AI with proper guidance produced work rated 40% higher and finished 25% faster. The method is the difference.

Why it's worth it: every prompt is written out in full, ready to paste, with the brackets marked so you fill in your own details. No theory, no filler - the wording that holds up when the work goes to someone senior.
